title: Pause in the Mystic Arch
description: A large white dog with spiral eyes and colorful patterns stands on stone steps, a black dripping silhouette figure on its side. To the right, a blue-haired wizard with a glowing staff and a golden dragon face a mummy-like figure wielding a blue lightsaber, all beneath a massive stone arch topped with a skull and a blood-red moon.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a large white dog with hypnotic spiral eyes and colorful tribal patterns standing on ancient stone steps, a black dripping silhouette figure attached to its side. A blue-haired wizard in dark robes holds a glowing purple staff beside a golden eastern dragon. In the foreground a mummy wields a blue lightsaber. They stand before a massive stone arch inscribed with runes, topped with a skull, with a giant red moon glowing behind it, floating bubbles containing tiny creatures fill the cosmic background.
